assets.function: A freestanding ceramic planter at a path entrance.
assets.appearance: Rounded terracotta pot with a thick rolled rim and a compact green shrub; retain the approved colors and intrinsic marks.
assets.structure: An open pot volume, integral flat underside, continuous rim and readable trunk-to-canopy gaps.

assets.structure: Solid seat, four separate leg contacts and visible cross braces.

_notes: This is a structural example, not real task evidence or generation authorization. Use actual asset IDs, sources and hashes.
Maintain only this asset/view registry. boards start derives scope, plan, descriptions and complete page jobs.
source supports asset_views, reference_views, or asset_proposals[].approved_reference_views with explicit view_id objects. Do not guess aliases from a view count.
For a genuinely new sourced scope with no older upstream JSON, omit source and explicitly set authority to registry. It does not mean human acceptance.
Shared pixel requirements are defaults. A view can override them only with an actual requirements_source_ref; upstream minima cannot be lowered.
Automatic pixel-budget single pages are valid. requires_single:true additionally needs single_exception:{source_ref,reason}; complex-main-asset prose is not an exemption.
The default subject_fill_ratio is a conservative 0.65 planning assumption, not a measured guarantee. Explicit overrides need subject_fill_source_ref. Never change quality minima to force a grid.

Same-asset views are grouped atomically when feasible. Otherwise start prepares one master first and visibly defers the remaining original views. Set asset.master_view_id to an explicitly requested view, or the first declared view is selected with that basis recorded.

boards advance accepts only a real technically qualified source crop with a visual pass bound to that exact image. It supplies the actual master and prepares only deferred views; missing or failed evidence remains waiting, not a new image submission.

All stages share the original WorkBuddy call/credit ceiling. Stage completion is not full-scope completion. boards compare requires the exact source and all target view hashes before a full multiview pass.
native_binding may be added as a hash-bound file reference once the current host tool mapping is known. WorkBuddy should use boards workbuddy for scoped guard registration and live binding.
New host sessions update operational binding and reconcile original pending calls. They do not clear old claims or make prior images newly accepted.
